name: Thai President Foods Public Company Limited
summary: Thai President Foods Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution of instant noodles, semi-instant foods, and biscuits products in Thailand and internationally. It also offers fruit juices, wheat flour-related, and bakery products; and manufactures and distributes paper packaging and packaging printing products, as well as provides packaging services for consumable products. In addition, the company is involved in the real estate investment and lending business; restaurant and drink business; and trading in rice bran. Thai President Foods Public Company Limited was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
